definition:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION icash_recording_private.voice_queue_slot_from_snapshot(p_account uuid, p_job uuid, p_snapshot jsonb)
 RETURNS boolean
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
 select exists(
  select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs j
  join public.icash_voice_contact_targets target on target.id=coalesce(j.permission_id,j.operational_contact_id)
   and target.account_id=j.account_id and target.party='seller' and target.contact_key is not null
   and ((j.permission_id is not null and j.operational_contact_id is null and target.eligibility_source='operator_record')
    or (j.permission_id is null and j.operational_contact_id is not null and target.eligibility_source='operational_checks_only'))
  where j.id=p_job and j.account_id=p_account and j.state='ready'
 and icash_recording_private.voice_capacity_from_snapshot(j.account_id,(select agent_id from public.icash_voice_configs where account_id=j.account_id),'voice:'||j.id,target.contact_key,false,p_snapshot)
  and not exists(
   select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs busy where busy.id<>j.id
    and (busy.state in ('issued','dispatching') or (busy.state='held' and busy.outcome in ('provider_receipt_needs_reconciliation','provider_outcome_unknown_no_retry')))
    and (exists(
     select 1 from public.icash_voice_contact_targets other where other.id=coalesce(busy.permission_id,busy.operational_contact_id)
      and other.account_id=busy.account_id and other.contact_key=target.contact_key
      and ((busy.permission_id is not null and busy.operational_contact_id is null and other.eligibility_source='operator_record')
       or (busy.permission_id is null and busy.operational_contact_id is not null and other.eligibility_source='operational_checks_only')))))
  and not exists(select 1 from public.icash_live_conversations live where live.state in ('waiting','review')
   and (live.contact_key=target.contact_key))
 );
$function$
target_view:
SELECT icash_contact_permissions.id,
    icash_contact_permissions.account_id,
    icash_contact_permissions.screening_id,
    icash_contact_permissions.party,
    icash_contact_permissions.phone,
    icash_contact_permissions.contact_key,
    icash_contact_permissions.timezone,
    icash_contact_permissions.local_start_hour,
    icash_contact_permissions.local_end_hour,
    icash_contact_permissions.permission_evidence,
    icash_contact_permissions.permission_until,
    icash_contact_permissions.dnc_checked_at,
    icash_contact_permissions.dnc_clear,
    icash_contact_permissions.revoked_at,
    icash_contact_permissions.buyer_id,
    icash_contact_permissions.review_request_id,
    'operator_record'::text AS eligibility_source
   FROM icash_contact_permissions
UNION ALL
 SELECT c.id,
    c.account_id,
    c.screening_id,
    'seller'::text AS party,
    c.phone,
    c.contact_key,
    c.timezone,
    c.local_start_hour,
    c.local_end_hour,
    NULL::text AS permission_evidence,
    c.eligibility_until AS permission_until,
    d.checked_at AS dnc_checked_at,
    d.clear AS dnc_clear,
    c.revoked_at,
    NULL::uuid AS buyer_id,
    NULL::uuid AS review_request_id,
    'operational_checks_only'::text AS eligibility_source
   FROM icash_operational_contacts c
     JOIN icash_dnc_verification_receipts d ON d.id = c.dnc_receipt_id
  WHERE c.channel = 'voice'::text;
busy_query:
select 1 from public.icash_voice_jobs busy where busy.id<>$1
    and (busy.state in ('issued','dispatching') or (busy.state='held' and busy.outcome in ('provider_receipt_needs_reconciliation','provider_outcome_unknown_no_retry')))
    and (exists(
     select 1 from public.icash_voice_contact_targets other where other.id=coalesce(busy.permission_id,busy.operational_contact_id)
      and other.account_id=busy.account_id and other.contact_key=$2
      and ((busy.permission_id is not null and busy.operational_contact_id is null and other.eligibility_source='operator_record')
       or (busy.permission_id is null and busy.operational_contact_id is not null and other.eligibility_source='operational_checks_only'))))
